headlines.title: 道明证券放弃按兵不动的预测，目前料美联储9月起将总计加息三次
headlines.summary: 道明证券策略师周五表示，他们预计美联储将在9月启动本轮三次加息中的第一次，此前他们的预测是2026年余下时间央行按兵不动。 包括Oscar Munoz和Gennadiy Goldberg在内的策略师在周五发布的研报中写道：“我们预计本轮周期总共将加息三次，后两次升息将在10月和明年1月进行。美联储可能不会提供前瞻指，但点阵图应会偏鹰。” 这一预期调整发生在周五公布的美国8月CPI高于预期后。该数据促使交易员提高了对美联储近期加息的预期。 上述策略师在报告中写道：“在8月CPI显示通胀缺乏进展后，我们预计美联储将在9月启动加息周期。”

headlines.title_en: TD Securities abandons its expectation for a hold, now expects the Fed to raise rates three times in total from September
headlines.summary_en: TD Securities strategists said Friday that they expect the Fed to begin the first of three rate hikes in this cycle in September, having previously forecast the central bank would hold rates steady for the remainder of 2026. "We expect a total of three hikes this cycle, with the latter two coming in October and next January. The Fed may not provide forward guidance, but the dot plot should be hawkish," strategists including Oscar Munoz and Gennadiy Goldberg wrote in a research note released Friday. The revision followed Friday's release of higher-than-expected US August CPI. The data prompted traders to raise their expectations for near-term Fed rate hikes. "After August CPI showed a lack of progress on inflation, we expect the Fed to begin its hiking cycle in September," the strategists wrote in the report.

headlines.title: 三菱日联预计美联储本月加息25基点，10月将按兵不动
headlines.summary: 三菱日联放弃了对于美联储今年维持利率不变的预估，预计央行将在9月加息25个基点。 策略师George Goncalves和Agron Nicaj调整预期的理由包括美联储主席沃什在杰克逊霍尔发表的偏鹰讲话、8月就业数据稳健，以及周五公布的CPI高于预期。 策略师写道，加息有可能成为一次“政策错误”，但在市场已经预期美联储下周加息的情况下，美联储很难选择按兵不动。他们表示：“鉴于沃什反复强调‘通胀是选项之一’，如果他什么都不做，会带来问题。”

headlines.title_en: MUFG expects the Fed to raise rates by 25bp this month and hold steady in October
headlines.summary_en: MUFG abandoned its forecast that the Federal Reserve will keep rates unchanged this year, and now expects the central bank to raise rates by 25 basis points in September. Strategists George Goncalves and Agron Nicaj cited Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish speech at Jackson Hole, solid August employment data, and Friday's higher-than-expected CPI as reasons for the revision. The strategists wrote that the hike could prove to be a "policy error," but with the market already expecting a Fed hike next week, it would be difficult for the Fed to choose to stand pat. "Given Warsh's repeated emphasis that 'inflation is one of the options,' it would create problems if he did nothing," they said.

headlines.title: 美国2026财年前11个月预算赤字累计达到1.96万亿美元
headlines.summary: 美国联邦政府本财年前11个月预算赤字达到1.96万亿美元，为有记录以来最高水平之一。财政部周五公布的数据显示，截至8月的11个月，赤字较2025年同期的1.97万亿美元小幅下降。单看8月，财赤缺口为1,668亿美元。财年最后一个月（即9月）通常会因为企业缴税期限而录得盈余。赤字扩大的部分原因是债务利息支出上升，而美债收益率上涨又是利息成本走高的原因之一。 财政部数据显示，截至8月底，可交易美国国债的平均利率升至3.48%，比五年前高出逾2个百分点。随着低收益率债券陆续到期，财政部不得不以更高成本再融资，这一平均利率预计还会继续上升。

headlines.title_en: The U.S. budget deficit reached $1.96 trillion cumulatively in the first 11 months of fiscal 2026
headlines.summary_en: The US federal government's budget deficit reached $1.96 trillion in the first 11 months of the fiscal year, one of the highest levels on record. Treasury Department data released Friday showed the deficit for the 11 months through August edged down from $1.97 trillion in the same period of 2025. For August alone, the budget gap was $166.8 billion. The final month of the fiscal year (September) typically records a surplus due to corporate tax deadlines. Part of the deficit widening is due to rising debt interest costs, and higher US Treasury yields are one reason for the increased interest costs. Treasury data showed the average rate on marketable US Treasury securities rose to 3.48% by the end of August, more than 2 percentage points higher than five years ago. As low-yield bonds mature, the Treasury must refinance at higher costs, and this average rate is expected to continue rising.

headlines.title_en: Wall Street: The Fed's rate decision may hinge on changes in mobile phone plans
headlines.summary_en: The latest CPI data showed that US wireless telephone service prices surged 5.9% in August, the largest increase in mobile phone service prices on record, contributing about 0.1 percentage point to the core reading. The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) declined to detail how changes by these carriers affected the data. Economists at Bank of America, Barclays and Pantheon Macroeconomics noted that recent plan adjustments by major carriers such as AT&T Inc. and T-Mobile US Inc. were likely the main drivers behind the price increase.

headlines.title: 美国9月消费者信心指数下滑
headlines.summary: 道明证券策略师周五表示，他们预计美联储将在9月启动本轮三次加息中的第一次，此前他们的预测是2026年余下时间央行按兵不动。 包括Oscar Munoz和Gennadiy Goldberg在内的策略师在周五发布的研报中写道：“我们预计本轮周期总共将加息三次，后两次升息将在10月和明年1月进行。美联储可能不会提供前瞻指，但点阵图应会偏鹰。” 这一预期调整发生在周五公布的美国8月CPI高于预期后。该数据促使交易员提高了对美联储近期加息的预期。 上述策略师在报告中写道：“在8月CPI显示通胀缺乏进展后，我们预计美联储将在9月启动加息周期。”

headlines.title: 安理会通过决议 对苏丹制裁授权进行一个月的技术性延期
headlines.summary: 金十数据9月12日讯，11日，联合国安理会通过一项决议，对苏丹制裁授权进行一个月的技术性延期。中国常驻联合国代表团临时代办孙磊在解释性发言中表示，考虑到安理会成员间分歧明显，对苏丹制裁授权进行一个月的技术性延期，使大家有更充分时间讨论，中方对此不持异议，在表决中投了赞成票。中方多次强调制裁是手段不是目的，不能成为外交努力的替代。当务之急是聚焦如何更好落实现有机制，随意扩大强制性措施范围只会恶化苏丹人道局势，甚至助推苏丹分裂前景，威胁地区稳定，损害安理会权威。中方希望在接下来的磋商中，各方尽早达成共识，为促进苏丹停火止战、维护苏丹团结统一发挥建设性作用。

headlines.title_en: Security Council adopts resolution for a one-month technical extension of the Sudan sanctions authorization
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 12 — On the 11th, the UN Security Council adopted a resolution granting a one-month technical extension of the Sudan sanctions mandate. Sun Lei, Chargé d'Affaires of China's Permanent Mission to the United Nations, said in an explanatory statement that given the obvious differences among Security Council members, a one-month technical extension of the Sudan sanctions mandate would give everyone more time for discussion, and China had no objection to this and voted in favor. China has repeatedly stressed that sanctions are a means, not an end, and cannot become a substitute for diplomatic efforts. The pressing task is to focus on how to better implement existing mechanisms; arbitrarily expanding the scope of coercive measures will only worsen Sudan's humanitarian situation, even fuel prospects for Sudan's division, threaten regional stability and undermine the authority of the Security Council. China hopes that in the upcoming consultations, all parties will reach consensus as soon as possible and play a constructive role in promoting a ceasefire and cessation of hostilities in Sudan and safeguarding Sudan's unity and territorial integrity.

headlines.title: 北交所出手严打“私下交易”，3名投资者被限制交易三个月
headlines.summary: 北交所对3名在新股发行过程中私下收购新股、约定新股收益分成的投资者作出处罚，采取限制证券账户交易三个月的自律监管措施。经认定，上述投资者在新股申购阶段达成私下约定，通过支付固定费用或约定打新收益安排，提前锁定投资收益，转移投资风险。根据相关法律法规，公开发行的证券应当在依法设立的证券交易场所交易。上述投资者行为绕开公开交易渠道，严重扰乱新股发行秩序，对市场生态造成恶劣影响。本次交易所果断出手，向市场释放了从严监管、理性打新的信号，有利于维护市场“三公”秩序，保护投资者合法权益。

headlines.title_en: Beijing Stock Exchange Cracks Down on 'Private Deals,' 3 Investors Barred from Trading for Three Months
headlines.summary_en: The Beijing Stock Exchange imposed penalties on three investors who privately acquired new shares during the IPO process and agreed to share in the gains from the new shares, taking self-regulatory measures to restrict securities account trading for three months. It was determined that the above investors reached private agreements during the new share subscription stage, locking in investment returns in advance and transferring investment risk by paying fixed fees or arranging to share new-share subscription gains. According to relevant laws and regulations, publicly issued securities shall be traded on securities trading venues established in accordance with law. The behavior of the above investors bypassed public trading channels, seriously disrupted the order of new share issuance and had a detrimental impact on the market ecosystem. The exchange's decisive action this time sends a signal to the market of strict regulation and rational new-share subscription, which is conducive to maintaining the "three fairness" order of the market and protecting the legitimate rights and interests of investors.

headlines.title: 美国核心CPI超预期上涨强化收紧理由 市场消化的加息概率飙升至90%
headlines.summary: 【美国核心CPI超预期上涨强化收紧理由 市场消化的加息概率飙升至90%】美国消费者价格的一项关键指标上个月超预期走高，为美联储下周的会议提供了上调利率的更多依据。美国劳工统计局周五公布的数据显示，剔除食品和能源的消费者价格指数8月环比上升0.3%。按同比计算，该指标上涨了2.4%。能源成本的增加推动总体消费者价格较前月上涨0.4%，而同比涨幅则为3.4%。期货交易显示，投资者认定下周的加息几乎已是板上钉钉，而且年底前二次上调利率的概率也相当高。

headlines.title_en: U.S. Core CPI Gains Beat Expectations, Bolstering Case for Tightening; Rate Hike Odds Priced In Soar to 90%
headlines.summary_en: [Higher-than-expected US core CPI strengthens case for tightening; market-implied probability of a rate hike surges to 90%] A key gauge of US consumer prices rose more than expected last month, providing the Fed with more grounds to raise rates at next week's meeting. Data released Friday by the US Bureau of Labor Statistics showed that the consumer price index excluding food and energy rose 0.3% in August from the previous month. On a year-over-year basis, the gauge rose 2.4%. Higher energy costs pushed headline consumer prices up 0.4% from the previous month, with a year-over-year increase of 3.4%. Futures trading showed investors believe a hike next week is almost a done deal, and the probability of a second rate increase before year-end is also quite high.
